query: I am working in AI and machine learning research. What are the upcoming calls relevant for me?
response:
As an AI and Machine Learning researcher, your opportunities exist primarily within Horizon Europe **Pillar II (Cluster 4)** for collaborative projects and **Pillar I (ERC, MSCA)** for individual grants. We have identified several upcoming opportunities, including highly strategic, large-scale calls.

### 1. Major Strategic Opportunity (EIC/Flagship)

One significant upcoming opportunity is offered by the European Innovation Council (EIC) under its Challenge-Driven framework. This type of call typically funds high-risk, high-impact breakthroughs in technology.

| ID | Title | Programme | Deadline | Focus |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **HORIZON-EIC-2026-AIC-01** | Accelerating Physical AI: Embodied Intelligence for the Next Frontier of AI-Powered Robotics | EIC Pathfinder | February 2026 | Physical AI, Robotics, Multimodal Perception, Trustworthy AI (expected total budget EUR 219M) |

### 2. Cluster 4: Digital, Industry & Space

The primary source for collaborative Research and Innovation Actions (RIA) and Innovation Actions (IA) in your field is **Cluster 4**. Upcoming calls usually focus on:

*   **Next Generation Computing:** Quantum AI, trustworthy data infrastructure, edge AI devices.
*   **AI for Manufacturing:** Integrating AI/ML into production lines (Industry 5.0).
*   **Trustworthy AI:** Implementing the EU AI Act, ensuring safety, robustness, and ethics in AI applications.
*   **Digital Twins and Robotics:** Advanced perception and autonomy systems.

*To find specific topics, look for Call IDs starting with `HORIZON-CL4-*` in the upcoming 2025/2026 Work Programmes.*

### 3. Cross-Cutting Funding for Individual Researchers (Pillar I)

Crucially, as a researcher, you are also eligible for the thematic-neutral funding schemes, which support excellence in any field, including AI and ML:

#### A. Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA)

MSCA funds researcher mobility, training, and career development. These calls are open to proposals on AI/ML research in any application domain.

| Action | Focus | Eligibility | Typical Deadline |
|---|---|---|---|
| **MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships (PF)** | Support experienced researchers (PhD holders) to conduct research abroad. | PhD holders (or 4+ years research experience) | September (Annual) |
| **MSCA Doctoral Networks (DN)** | Fund collaborative training networks for PhD candidates across sectors. | Consortium (Min 3 partners) | November (Annual) |
| **MSCA Staff Exchanges (SE)** | Short-term secondments for staff to transfer knowledge. | Consortium (Min 3 partners) | February/March (Annual) |

#### B. European Research Council (ERC) Grants

ERC grants support ground-breaking, high-risk, high-gain frontier research conducted by excellent Principal Investigators (PIs) in any field (including theoretical and applied AI/ML).

| Grant Type | PI Profile | Focus | Typical Funding (Max) |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Starting Grant (StG)** | 2-7 years post-PhD | Establishing independence | €1.5 Million (5 years) |
| **Consolidator Grant (CoG)** | 7-12 years post-PhD | Consolidating research independence | €2 Million (5 years) |
| **Advanced Grant (AdG)** | Established research leaders | Major research breakthroughs | €2.5 Million (5 years) |

### Actionable Guidance

To prepare for these upcoming calls, we recommend the following steps:

🎯 **Getting Started with Horizon Europe:**
• Register on [EU Funding & Tenders Portal](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/home)
• Review the [Work Programmes](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents;programCode=HORIZON) for **Cluster 4** and **EIC**.
• Search for similar funded AI projects using [Partner Search](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/partner-search) to identify potential consortium members.
• Check the [Call Calendar](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/calls-calendar) for precise deadlines.
